explanation: Q1 selects drinkers who only frequent bars serving beers they like, while Q2 selects drinkers who do not frequent any bar serving a beer they like. The difference arises when a drinker frequents bars serving only beers they dislike (Q2 includes them, Q1 excludes them).
counterexample_dsp: A drinker (Alice) frequents bars that serve beers not in her likes (BeerX, BeerY). She likes BeerZ, which is not served by any bar she frequents. Q1 excludes her (bars serve disliked beers), Q2 includes her (no liked beers served at frequented bars).
